title: AI Providers, Knowledge, and Assistants
readerIntent: Understand Nodics AI capabilities and their authority boundaries.
priorKnowledge: Understand schemas, search, services, workflows, and security.
owner: aiProviders, aiKnowledge, aiAssistant, and owning Nodics business capabilities
summary: Nodics provides configurable AI generation, embeddings, governed knowledge retrieval, conversational assistance, tool execution, and usage governance without granting AI direct infrastructure authority.

sections.heading: Authority map
items: aiProviders is the only provider-neutral AI gateway; callers never import vendor adapters.
aiKnowledge owns corpus ingestion, versioned retrieval evidence, and citations; nSearch executes search.
aiAssistant owns conversations, turns, streaming, tool orchestration, confirmations, and recovery.
Target modules retain authorization, validation, persistence, and business execution.
Workflow retains durable multi-step process authority.
Generated schema services and nDatabase own persistence; AI modules never connect directly to a database.

sections.heading: Default safety
items: AI capabilities and vendor adapters are disabled until configured.
Provider/model selection, pricing, credentials, limits, and kill switches are backend configuration.
Retrieved content is untrusted reference data, not executable instruction.
Material mutations require immutable arguments, explicit confirmation, target authorization, idempotency, and workflow handoff where configured.
